configurations.name: docket-web
runtimeArgs: PREFIX=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | sed 's#.*/##'); if [ "$PREFIX" = "main" ]; then WEB_HOST=docket.localhost; API_HOST=api.docket.localhost; else WEB_HOST=$PREFIX.docket.localhost; API_HOST=$PREFIX.api.docket.localhost; fi; export API_URL=https://$API_HOST NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://$API_HOST NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://$WEB_HOST BETTER_AUTH_URL=https://$API_HOST BETTER_AUTH_PASSKEY_RP_ID=$WEB_HOST NEXT_PUBLIC_PASSKEY_RP_ID=$WEB_HOST BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://$WEB_HOST,https://$API_HOST NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=$HOME/.portless/ca.pem; echo "[launch] web=https://$WEB_HOST api=https://$API_HOST"; pnpm exec dotenv -e .env.local -- pnpm exec turbo run dev --filter=@docket/web --filter=@docket/api
